2025 general season: 38 elk (36 antlered, 2 antlerless). Muzzleloader: 2 four-points, 8 five-points, 3 six-plus; 798 hunter-days. General and special combined: 47 elk, including 9 antlerless special harvest. Muzzleloader totals combine early and late seasons.

WDFW 2025 general harvest · Combined harvest
Public land & timber access

Green: DNR trust, USFS, BLM and WDFW hunting lands. Blue: TCT Columbia walk-in and reservation tracts. Red: elk-hunting closures and muzzleloader restrictions.

Elk Area 5062, Trout Lake: no muzzleloaders October 1–January 30. Conboy Lake NWR is closed to elk hunting; Trout Lake NAP is excluded. Natural areas and tribal parcels have separate authorization requirements.

Weapon restrictions · Refuge rules

Closures, boundaries and source links

Closed to elk hunting: Conboy Lake National Wildlife Refuge (bird hunting only) and Trout Lake Natural Area Preserve. Western Pacific Timber's Klickitat County lands have been closed to hunting access since Sept. 1, 2023. Industrial gates and seasonal closures may change.

WDFW Region 5 reports elk opportunities primarily in northern and western GMU 578; approximately 71% of the unit is privately owned. The north portion overlaps Tract D.

GMU 578 FIELD INTEL

Elk leads & access contacts

Reviewed Nov 19

North and west side elk country

WDFW · 2026 District 9 prospects

WDFW identifies the northern and western portions of 578 as the unit’s elk opportunity. Match the historical Trout Lake and Quigley Butte areas to legal timber entries and fresh sign.

District 9 report

Three participating timber-access properties

Trout Lake #993 and West Klickitat #994 offer walk-in hunting on enrolled ground. Strong Road #988 requires an online reservation for hunting or scouting in season. November 16–30 lists one group of up to five; check remaining availability.

WDFW Private Lands Biologist Thayne Aubrey

Strong Road rules / reservations

AFM / Broughton / DGS · free walk-in timber

American Forest Management · Columbia Gorge District

Open Broughton and DGS properties allow recreation without a permit or fee, subject to posted and fire closures. Current maps cover Snowden, Oklahoma Road, Arrowhead, Gilmer–Winegartner and other blocks. Mill A / Underwood Broughton land and all Klickitat Holdings land are closed.

Official access maps & contact

Manulife timberland · access-status hotline

WDFW · 2026 District 9 prospects · GMUs 578 / 388

WDFW lists Manulife timberland as generally allowing non-motorized access. Check the named property and current gate status with the published access hotline: 509-364-3331.

WDFW landowner-access report

Timber-company access changes

WDFW · 2026 District 9 prospects

Western Pacific Timber land in Klickitat County is closed to public hunting access. Broughton’s Mill A / Underwood ground, Lupine’s Gilmer / Arrowhead ground and all Klickitat Holdings properties also have closures. Use current participating-property records for entry choices.

Landowner-access section

Hunter reports · thick cover after road pressure

Rokslide · December 9–10, 2025 · neighboring SW Washington units

Hunters describe increased elk encounters after leaving logging roads for thicker cover; one reported elk leaving after a gate was forced open. Apply this scouting tactic to legal walk-in timber in 578.

Trout Lake-area hunting connections

Northwest Firearms · November 1, 2018 · historical discussion

A Trout Lake-area elk-partner thread connects hunters planning several-mile walk-in hunts and pack-outs. Public forum accounts can provide scouting connections; arrange introductions through the forum.
